audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers rendered different level charts. Content read Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Garen / Skill / Garen / Garen / Skill — matching the packet exactly. The full layer read Skill / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Skill / Skill / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger. Five of seven rows disagreed, so the page answered 'who wins Level 3' two different ways.
audit.why: The content whys are the accurate read: Heimerdinger owns levels 1-2 because Garen has no ranged tool at all, Garen owns level 3 (Decisive Strike spike vs an unlearned or rank-1 CH-3X), levels 4-5 are even, and Garen owns 6 onward once Demacian Justice exists.
audit.corrected: Full layer flipped to the content/packet chart on rows 0, 2, 4, 5 and 6 with ratings re-cut, proposed as one atomic group. No content-layer chart edits are needed — that layer was already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4] said 'Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in' and phases[5] called Liandry's Torment the fight-forcing spike. Level 6 and first item are both Garen's spikes in this lane.
audit.why: Demacian Justice is a missing-health execute at 120/100/80s, and Garen's first-item Stridebreaker or Phage supplies the gap-close his base kit does not have. Heimerdinger's UPGRADE!!! is 100s at rank 1 and does not answer an execute on an immobile, dashless champion.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now states the execute pattern; phases[5].why states the Stridebreaker/Phage gap-close; phases[6].why states the even late read.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer pointed every 'track his cooldown' line at Courage and described it only as 'Damage reduction. Poke when down.' The decisive interaction — Decisive Strike SILENCING the grenade — appeared nowhere in the full layer.
audit.why: Riot's text: Decisive Strike gives a burst of move speed, BREAKS FREE OF ALL SLOWS affecting him, and his next attack silences. That single ability answers three of Heimerdinger's tools at once — it cleans off the beam and grenade slows, it is an auto-attack reset (the wind-up, not the cast, is the tell), and the silence blanks CH-3X on an 8s cooldown. Courage at 22s rank 1 shields and grants tenacity but is the secondary concern.
audit.corrected: tldr, dosFull[0].d and dosFull[2].d now name Decisive Strike's 8s cooldown, its slow-break, its silence and its auto-reset wind-up; Courage's 22s and its shield-plus-tenacity go on dontsFull[1].d and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet defect line was accurate: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. Not one real number appeared in the full layer.
audit.why: Concrete timers are what make the advice actionable: Decisive Strike 8s flat, Courage 22s at rank 1, Judgment 9s at rank 1, Demacian Justice 120s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: 8s and 22s are now written into tldr and the dos/donts descriptions.

edits.before: One turret + AA wins level 1 against almost everyone. Identify how Garen contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: You bank a turret and the slowing beam taxes his every step — he has no ranged poke, and Q-silence is dead until he reaches you.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Garen must walk into your range.
edits.after: He hits his level-3 Decisive Strike spike while CH-3X is weak or unlearned — he Q-silences in and trades short.

edits.before: Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in — choose per fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Garen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Demacian Justice is missing-HP true damage — once chipped, Decisive Strike plus R executes you straight through the turrets.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Courage's cooldown.
edits.after: Stridebreaker or Phage gives him the gap-close his kit lacks — his Q lands before beams ramp.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Garen carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Even late: you own the siege, but a fed Garen Q-silences past the nest and R-executes you — no clean 1v1 owner.

edits.before: Turret-zone his spin — E-stun his Q-E, poke. Heimerdinger wins the Courage cooldown windows.
edits.after: Decisive Strike (8s) silences your grenade — bank the nest and hold CH-3X for his step-in.

edits.before: Zone and E-stun his spin. Track Courage before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Zone him off CS with W rockets and save CH-3X for his commit — keep HP topped so R cannot execute.

edits.before: Garen wins by landing Courage, denying your pattern, and out-trading your engage windows.
edits.after: Garen wins by Q-silencing through the nest onto a chipped yordle and executing with R.

edits.before: Damage reduction. Poke when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Courage is 22s at rank 1 — it shields and gives tenacity. Poke it out.

edits.before: Garen wastes Courage — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Decisive Strike is an auto reset — the wind-up is your cue.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Courage shields and reduces damage — wait it out, then commit.

notes: The content layer for this matchup was already accurate, specific and packet-aligned — no content edits were required, including for the chart. Every defect was confined to the full layer, which was still carrying the generic 'track his signature cooldown' template pointed at the wrong ability (Courage) while the genuinely matchup-defining one (Decisive Strike's silence and slow-break) was never mentioned there. NOT ASSERTED, not answerable from the kit files: whether Courage's tenacity meaningfully shortens the CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade stun, and whether Judgment can destroy an H-28 G turret during its placement animation. Both would change trading advice if true — flagging rather than guessing.
